summary: @ornikar/babel-preset-base 6.0.12 preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: The package advertises itself as a Babel preset but ships install-time code unrelated to that purpose. package.json declares scripts.preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (architecture-selected zip), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a shipped math_init.js via execFileSync. math_init.js is a 727 KB single-module bundle with a `// @bun @bun-cjs` header whose control flow is hidden behind a shuffled string/number dictionary (`n7gIxM`), a rotation function (`WV8StW`), and a custom character-substitution decoder (`hc1jfK9`); the identifiers are randomized and the code is not human-readable. The package's advertised entry (index.js) is a ~30-line Babel preset with no build-time need for an alternate language runtime. Running `npm install` on this version causes an obfuscated payload to execute on the installer host through a runtime the Babel preset has no legitimate reason to introduce.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
